skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: A Thousand Correspondences
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Thousand Correspondences. A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.
skins.quote: Heidi has sent a thousand letters, ranging from her teenage dreams to heartfelt essays, keeping the replies in a box she carries around. She has met some of her recipients, but others she will never hear from again.
